reviews.comment: Its early days, and the jury is still out, but ut seems fantastic the AI models I can run are stageing, and not having to look over my shoulder to make sre the online LLMs are not taking over my work is great. Heat is the issue I need to solve.

reviews.title: Underated Beast of a card
reviews.comment: Bought this card to replaced My rtx 3080 fe and loved it, so far no issue. I would recommend this product. I would not be surprise if I see the price of it now to be more than 1k when its available again.
